profiles.description: Native LLaMEA with HPO evaluation supplied by an explicit research factory.

evaluation.description: Native LLaMEA HPO=True requests configuration spaces; the factory evaluator must perform the intended inner HPO and benchmark validation.

argument_help: Factory returns f, llm and optional LLaMEA constructor arguments. Use the released example as the HPO evaluator reference.
limitations: The example script passes mutation_prompts, absent from the current pinned LLaMEA constructor; use the native API driver rather than claiming the stale example executes.
HPO=True alone does not implement SMAC: the user factory must supply the actual HPO evaluation function.

profiles.description: Native LLaMEA with packaged BBOB AOCC evaluator; explicit pilot budgets. HPO variant retains native SMAC facade with compatibility fixes.

evaluation.description: Native LLaMEA with packaged BBOB AOCC evaluator; explicit pilot budgets. HPO variant retains native SMAC facade with compatibility fixes.

argument_help: --model gpt-5.6-sol; scoped OPENAI_API_KEY via explicit environment_names.
limitations: Native evaluation only; canonical_evaluation=false. Pilot budgets do not reproduce paper-scale experiments.
No provider token/temperature enforcement; native retry/parse behavior can exceed nominal sample count; outer timeout applies.

HPO profile fixes obsolete Solution.keys() check and string instance IDs, uses8 SMAC trials and1000 objective calls; ordinary evaluator unchanged. Native max_workers=1 does not guarantee per-candidate timeout; admitted outer cgroup2400s is authoritative.
